title: Ayam Goreng Kiam Boi - Fried Chicken with Fruit Seasoning
ldName: Ayam Goreng Kiam Boi - Fried Chicken with Fruit Seasoning
ldInstructionsRaw: Combine fried chicken powder, fruit salt seasoning, and water in a mixing bowl. Add chicken pieces to the batter to fully coat and let marinate for 4 hours in the fridge.
Heat enough oil in a wok for deep frying. Fry chicken pieces until golden brown and crispy and fully cooked, about 8 minutes per batch.
Drain chicken on paper towel and serve immediately.
